_comment: Static dataset for the Interface Draw List Buffer (dev) report.
Nothing here comes from this repo's autoplay stats DB. The figures are one-off
measurements of a live CivilizationV_DX11.exe taken in the Community-Patch-DLL
workspace (.claude/skills/civ5-game-ui/experiments/mod-graphics-cost/render-buffer):
capture.py copies one complete frame of the buffer with ReadProcessMemory, and
survey.py hides each visible Lua context in turn and reads the frame again, so a
context's share is the bytes that disappear with it. Yield icons are the exception:
the engine draws them itself, so their share is the frame with them on minus off.
Live scenes: one paused game, 2026-10-06 (turn-280 huge-map save, 2560x1440,
Vox Populi + EUI). The crash scene is a different game: two full crash dumps of
2026-09-29/30 with 440 Machine Guns in view, both holding the same frame.
All sizes are bytes. Every scene's users sum to its 'used'. A user's bytes are
sprites x 240 + texts x 144 + panels x 352 (the crash scene carries 144 bytes the
record index does not account for, kept in 'Everything else').
'calculated' marks numbers derived by arithmetic rather than read from a frame.
frames[].flags is the part of 'used' that the frame's own unit flags took (from the
survey of that view; null where it was not measured). The report's 'units that fit'
table is floor((capacity - (used - flags)) / flagCosts[].bytes): the frame with its
own flags taken out, refilled with flags of one cost. Flag costs: 6 sprites plus one
per promotion icon, 240 B each (0, 2 and 4 icons measured, 13 calculated).
